title: Gym Mirror Progress Shot Consistency Studio — Gemini model variant
description: A developer-operated Gemini rerun of the canonical Gym Mirror Progress Shot Consistency Studio brief, preserved as an auditable PathForge Labs model variant rather than a community fork.

comparison_basis.opening_prompt_exact: I want a saveable, openable Gym Mirror Progress Shot Consistency Studio for tablet and desktop that helps me make comparable gym progress photos with pose, angle, lighting, background cards, privacy crop checks, retake warnings, a session comparison score, and a copyable shoot receipt, without needing to upload images.
acceptance_criteria: Provide repeatable pose, angle, lighting, background, distance, and timing setup controls without requiring image upload.
Include privacy crop checks and useful retake warnings before a session is accepted.
Calculate a meaningful comparability score from the selected setup and preserve a usable session history.
Provide a copyable shoot receipt that makes the next progress-photo session repeatable.
Produce one complete self-contained HTML file that is immediately usable in a browser.
Operate offline with no external APIs, hosted generation, CDNs, remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or fragile dependencies.
Avoid unsafe HTML sinks, eval-like execution, inline event handlers, modal dialogs, and deprecated clipboard handling.
Avoid page-level horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 and at desktop width.
Keep essential controls visible, keyboard or touch reachable, and truthful about their current state.
Preserve exact prompt, response, source, and artifact-version evidence for the run.
comparison_basis.adaptive_repair_policy: Preserve and score the first real artifact. Continue only when verification proves a concrete defect or a source-capture failure; use the same source session and model; name the observed defect in ordinary language; preserve every real artifact version; stop as soon as the artifact passes; prefer no more than three total prompts and go beyond three only for a documented concrete lane reason such as a verification-proven regression, truncation, or mechanical capture failure.
comparison_basis.independence_note: Gemini received the invariant brief in a fresh session and was not shown the historical implementation, screenshots, source code, or another provider's output.

agent_notes: Model settings: Gemini web; 3.1 Pro mode (Advanced math and code) visibly selected before the opening prompt; both verification-driven repairs stayed in the same source session.
PathForge Labs provenance: developer-operated comparison run; not a user, community fork, vote, bookmark, or engagement event.

Gemini's Copy prompt control normalized the contract opener's terminal newline in its visible rendering; the browser was filled with the immutable contract bytes, including that terminal newline, before Send was clicked.
Prompt count: 4. Prompts 2 and 3 repaired concrete workflow and safety defects; prompt 4 was a release-scanner-only mechanical repair that reworded one comment and changed no executable behavior.
All four real artifact versions are preserved under public/artifacts. The repair-3 artifact is the default selectable version for this model run.

Final verification passed all ten fixed contract checks and hard gates; a direct diff from repair-2 to repair-3 showed exactly one comment-line change, with fresh zero-overflow and zero-console-error mobile and desktop measurements.

artifact_version_notes.disposition: Preserved first response; not default because it required image uploads, omitted distance, timing, and session history, and used deprecated clipboard handling.
Preserved second response; it restored the contracted no-upload workflow but verification found innerHTML writes, alert/confirm modals, deprecated clipboard handling, and pointer-only cards.
Preserved previously verified artifact; superseded only because the release scanner found the forbidden dynamic-HTML token in a safety comment.
Final verified Gemini artifact and default version; a comment-only repair removed the forbidden scanner token without changing executable behavior.

verification_notes: The final artifact's single inline script parsed successfully.

Static scan found no remote dependency, API call, remote font, unsafe HTML sink or token, eval-like execution, inline handler, document.write, browser modal, deprecated clipboard handling, or negative letter spacing.

A direct diff from repair-2 to repair-3 showed exactly one change: the safety comment was reworded; markup, styles, executable JavaScript, controls, text, and data were otherwise byte-for-byte unchanged.

The previously verified workflow remains intact: six no-upload setup factors, 100/100 baseline, 83/100 deviation with retake warning, 3/3 privacy receipt evidence, persistent history, and in-page clear controls.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors.

steps.title: Build the invariant Gym progress-shot consistency brief
steps.prompt_exact: I want a saveable, openable Gym Mirror Progress Shot Consistency Studio for tablet and desktop that helps me make comparable gym progress photos with pose, angle, lighting, background cards, privacy crop checks, retake warnings, a session comparison score, and a copyable shoot receipt, without needing to upload images.
steps.response_summary: Gemini produced the first complete one-file artifact.
steps.notes: Preserved unmodified. Verification found an upload-dependent workflow, missing distance/timing/history, and deprecated clipboard handling.

steps.title: Replace uploads with the contracted no-upload setup studio
steps.prompt_exact: The app you made depends on uploading reference and current images, but I specifically need it to work without any image uploads. It also reduces the setup to four checkboxes, so there are no actual selectable pose, camera angle, lighting, background, camera distance, or timing controls, and there is no session history for comparing prior setups. Replace the upload workflow with a visual shot-setup board built from selectable setup cards for all six factors, add privacy-crop checks and clear retake warnings based on the selections, calculate a meaningful comparability score against a saved baseline, keep a useful local session history, and make the repeatable shoot receipt copyable. Preserve the polished tablet/desktop experience, make it usable at 390 pixels without horizontal overflow, and return the complete self-contained HTML again.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a complete six-factor setup studio with baseline scoring and local history.
steps.continuation_reason: Verification found the first artifact depended on image uploads, omitted distance and timing controls, and had no session history.
steps.notes: Preserved unmodified. Static verification then found unsafe DOM sinks, blocking modals, deprecated clipboard handling, and pointer-only cards.

steps.title: Repair static safety and keyboard operability
steps.prompt_exact: Static verification found four concrete safety and usability defects in the repaired file: it writes warning and history markup through innerHTML, uses alert and confirm browser modals, copies through deprecated document.execCommand, and makes the setup cards pointer-only divs instead of keyboard-operable controls. Replace every innerHTML write with createElement and textContent, replace the blocking modals with visible in-page status and confirm/cancel controls, use navigator.clipboard.writeText with clear in-page success or failure feedback, and make every setup card a real button that works by keyboard. Keep the complete no-upload workflow, all six setup factors, baseline scoring, privacy checks, retake warnings, local history, receipt, responsive layout, and existing visual polish unchanged. Return the complete self-contained HTML again.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned the complete safe, keyboard-operable no-upload studio.
steps.continuation_reason: Static verification found innerHTML writes, alert and confirm modals, document.execCommand copying, and pointer-only setup cards.
steps.notes: Final verified artifact; all ten contract checks and hard gates passed.

steps.title: Remove the forbidden scanner token from the verified file
steps.prompt_exact: The final file works, but the release scan still finds the forbidden literal innerHTML in this safety comment: // Construct warning DOM safely without innerHTML. Remove or reword only that comment so the literal token does not appear anywhere in the HTML. Do not change any markup, styling, JavaScript behavior, controls, text, or data. Return the complete self-contained HTML again.
